<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="definitions"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="CarInsurerPool"
                      name="Car Insurer"
                      processRef="CarInsurerProcess" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="CarInsurerProcess" isExecutable="false">
    <!-- Lanes -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_1">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Notification"
                  name="Notification Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RegisterClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Handling"
                  name="Handling Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PickUpClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PerformAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AssessmentDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PhoneGarage</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SchedulePayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RejectClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendLetter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Completed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Flow nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1"
                     name="Customer submits claim with documentation" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDocuments"
               name="Check documents for completeness" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterClaim"
               name="Register the claim" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickUpClaim"
               name="Pick up the claim" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckInsurance"
               name="Check the insurance" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PerformAssessment"
               name="Perform assessment" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AssessmentDecision"
                          name="Assessment positive?" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneGarage"
               name="Phone garage to authorise repairs" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SchedulePayment"
               name="Schedule the payment" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RejectClaim"
               name="Reject the claim" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge"
                          name="Merge paths" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendLetter"
               name="Send letter to customer" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed"
                   name="Process complete" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1"
                       sourceRef="StartEvent_1"
                       targetRef="Task_CheckDocuments" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2"
                       sourceRef="Task_CheckDocuments"
                       targetRef="Task_RegisterClaim" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3"
                       sourceRef="Task_RegisterClaim"
                       targetRef="Task_PickUpClaim" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4"
                       sourceRef="Task_PickUpClaim"
                       targetRef="Task_CheckInsurance" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5"
                       sourceRef="Task_CheckInsurance"
                       targetRef="Task_PerformAssessment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6"
                       sourceRef="Task_PerformAssessment"
                       targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentDecision" />
    <!-- Positive branch -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PosYes"
                       name="yes"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentDecision"
                       targetRef="Task_PhoneGarage">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">assessment == "positive"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7"
                       sourceRef="Task_PhoneGarage"
                       targetRef="Task_SchedulePayment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8"
                       sourceRef="Task_SchedulePayment"
                       targetRef="Gateway_Merge" />
    <!-- Negative branch -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PosNo"
                       name="no"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentDecision"
                       targetRef="Task_RejectClaim">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">assessment == "negative"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9"
                       sourceRef="Task_RejectClaim"
                       targetRef="Gateway_Merge" />
    <!-- After merge -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_Merge"
                       targetRef="Task_SendLetter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11"
                       sourceRef="Task_SendLetter"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_Completed" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
